channel.title: RSS Aggregator Feed
channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: Apple may try to increase revenue by doing…something with third-party AI apps
item.description: Apple hinted at ways that it could spur revenue through third-party "opportunities" during its Monday night earnings call.

item.title: This Chinese Android phone brand has launched a Harry Potter collab
item.description: Everything about this latest collectible Android phone is designed to evoke the popular franchise, from its magical packaging to its themed accessories.

item.title: Palantir cofounder wants a 30,000 monkey farm in the US — because AI jacked up macaque prices by 700% in seven years
item.description: Palantir cofounder Joe Lonsdale reportedly backs a US startup planning a 30,000 capacity monkey farm amid rising prices and restricted international supplies.

item.title: Ukraine’s new pocket-sized gadget turns Russian drones’ cameras against them
item.description: A Kyiv startup’s pocket-sized, 10-ounce receiver lets Ukrainian troops watch the video feeds of Russian drones, though Russian moves toward digital video and AI-guided drones that emit no signals could make the victory short-lived.

item.title: DeepSeek Harness new Creator Mode creates plugins from prompts
item.description: DeepSeek Harness has added a new Creator Mode, which aims to create plugins directly from prompts.
